workingTree: A patient can be created from the counter (POST /api/customers). Also carries the AI scribe, the SOAP routing, the sidebar work and the Triage/Consultations rename.
//counts: Measured 2026-10-10 after routing the scribe into SOAP: 2185/1443/735/7 with NO database, and 2185/2180/0/5 against a local PostgreSQL 17.10. +3 over the consent-gate figures, all three database-free, so the SKIPPED ceiling did not move. Client 416. THE RULE DID NOT CHANGE; IT MOVED TO THE RIGHT PLACE. The scribe used to draft the Subjective and nothing else, on the rule that a model drafting an assessment is a model making a clinical decision. That rule stands. What was wrong is WHERE it sat: when a pharmacist says out loud "chest is clear, looks viral, honey and fluids, come back in five days", the assessment and the plan were MADE BY A PERSON, and writing them into the right boxes is transcription. Refusing was not safety, it was making a pharmacist retype a decision they had already spoken. So the line moved from WHICH SECTION to WHOSE WORDS: the patient’s voice drafts Subjective and nothing else, the pharmacist’s drafts Objective, Assessment and Plan, and a voice that said nothing drafts nothing. The structured records (problems, interventions, referral, prescription, care-program, summary) stay forbidden, and now for a sharper reason: they are not prose but records with their own validation and their own audit trail. ONE model call with both halves labelled, because the owner asked for swift and this deployment’s model reasons for seconds - but the labelling is a HINT and each section is then validated against the words of the person who owns it, so a model that files the pharmacist’s advice as the patient’s report is caught rather than trusted. A NEW REFUSAL, hardenedACertainty: an assessment that drops a hedge the pharmacist used. "I think it MIGHT be viral" filed as "Viral upper respiratory infection" has turned a working impression into a diagnosis and the next reader cannot tell. Asked only of the Assessment, because that is the section where certainty IS the clinical content. WITHINTRANSCRIPT BECAME A RATIO, and this is a LOOSENING named as one. The first live run refused the Subjective as longer_than_transcript at 462 characters from 444 of speech - FOUR PER CENT over, on the normal case, for the most important section. Measured: subjective 1.04, objective 0.21, assessment 0.24, plan 0.44, because the Subjective covers ALL of a patient’s speech while the others cover part of the pharmacist’s. Capped at 1.5 now. It still catches a model answering a short recording with paragraphs; it never caught a fabricated symptom that fits inside the budget, at any threshold, because that is SHORTER - which needs entity-level grounding and has its own task. Six mutations run against the new safety logic and all six turned the right test red. TWO EXISTING INVARIANTS WERE AMENDED WITH THE PRODUCT, NOT RELAXED. scribeContract’s pinned SCRIBABLE === [subjective]; it now pins the stronger claim that every section is drafted from the voice that owns it AND that a forbidden section has no owning voice at all. consultationLayout’s microphone invariant pinned an early return the mode machine replaced; it now pins REACHABILITY - the microphone is opened in exactly one place, that place renders only under mode ready, and ready is reachable only via a consented note or the server’s own acceptance of consent. Measured again 2026-10-11 after adding counter patient creation: 2192/1450/735/7 with NO database and 2192/2187/0/5 with one. +7, all database-free, so the skipped ceiling did not move. The feature is an INSERT NOBODY WROTE: the route calls customerIdentity.resolveCustomer, the existing upsert that is atomic by constraint, rather than inserting into customers itself - because identity_key is unique per pharmacy and a hand-written INSERT would have worked today and produced a DUPLICATE the first time that person texted. Proven against a real database: 0803 999 1122 typed at the counter creates (201); +2348039991122 returns the SAME id with created:false (200); and the same number arriving over WhatsApp resolves to that same row, leaving ONE row for the identity, with the pharmacist's full_name surviving while display_name becomes what WhatsApp calls them (the 0020 split). A PHONE NUMBER IS REQUIRED and that is a schema fact: wa_jid is NOT NULL (0016) and identity_key is NOT NULL (0019). A walk-in with NO phone is therefore not supported, and supporting one means making wa_jid nullable, which is a change to the live identity path and belongs in its own commit. wa_jid is synthesised as <number>@s.whatsapp.net and overwritten with the real one on first message; nothing can send to it meanwhile because messageInput's outreach gate refuses a patient who has not written first. 8 mutations run and the EIGHTH WAS MISSED, which taught something: deleting the required-phone check still refuses an empty box, falling through to the parser and saying "that does not look like a phone number" - safe, and wrong for the person, because an empty field is not a malformed one. The test now asserts the MESSAGE and the mutation then failed.

//lastChange: Chats and Workflows at the top (owner, 2026-10-12). WORKFLOWS LEFT CLINICS hours after joining it - "the workflow is not a subset of clinic module" - and is a top-level destination beside Chats, above the modules, as a SEGMENTED CONTROL rather than two sidebar rows: Chats and Workflows are a choice between two ways of working, where the modules below are places. A place list opening with these two would read as though Workflows were a screen like Orders. CHATS IS HOME, not a second surface: Home was already the default landing state and already the greeting plus one input, which is what the reference shows, so this names what was there rather than growing a rival screen to keep in step. THE RECORD CONTROL MOVED INTO THE COMPOSER AND OPENS THE CONSULTATION RATHER THAN A MICROPHONE, which is the whole of the decision rather than a shortcut around it. Transcription is bound to POST /customers/:id/consultations/:consultationId/scribe behind scribeGate, re-read from the database on every request and failing closed; 0071 added the consent columns so "we do not record anyone who was not asked" stays true without anybody maintaining it. There is NO patient-free transcribe endpoint, and adding one to put a mic on this box would be a door marked "dictate your question" that a patient can be recorded through. Labelled "Record a consultation", never a bare "Record": a button that then asks a question is a small lie told at the exact moment somebody is about to speak to a patient. TWO TESTS AMENDED WITH THE PRODUCT. modules.test.js twice in one day, the second undoing the first - the honest record of a decision being corrected. And homeCommand.test.jsx’s "Home has no microphone", whose own comment had predicted this implementation ("a mic on Home could only ask for a patient first"), was amended AND TIGHTENED: it banned the WORD Record, which would have passed a box that silently called getUserMedia under another label; it now asserts the component opens no microphone at all. The new ui- classes got styles in the same commit, after the consultation workspace once shipped six class names with none. 7 client tests, 11 mutations, 11 caught. Client 409 -> 416. No server file touched.
